Reshaping to Game Level

gameLong is the workhorse: one row per participant per week per game.

Entering Weekly Winners

The matchups are read straight out of the data, so no schedule needs to be typed by hand. On the first run of a new week, a new sheet (“Week N”) is appended to Winners/winners.xlsx with blank rows for that week’s games — fill in the Winner column there (exact team name, matching Team1 or Team2) and re-render. Existing sheets and entries are never overwritten.

If a game ends in a tie, type Tie in the Winner column (not case sensitive). A tie is treated as a scored game in which both sides lose the bet, and the game is omitted from % correct and Brier calculations. A blank cell still means “not yet played / not yet entered”.

Division Win Likelihood

Starting in Week 6, participants rated how likely each of the 32 teams is to win its division (0 to 100 for each team, no requirement that a division adds to 100). Each answer is stored as one JSON value, which is unpacked here to one row per participant, week and team.

NFL Fan Survey

Prolific ID Check

All analyses below use 217 respondents.

Team Strength

Participants placed every team into one of five playoff-outlook categories. Teams are sorted by the average category, so the teams most expected to make the playoffs are at the top.

Team Affinity

Participants placed every team into one of five categories describing how much they like the team (not how well it will perform). Teams are sorted by average affinity, with the most liked at the top.
